personality_one_liner: A high-contrast, tactical command-center interface built for urgency, clear live tracking, and fast response.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing around core emergency actions to prevent mis-taps. Tight, grouped spacing for metadata and metrics.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary with correct elevation for better readability in high-stress/low-light environments.
dont's: Avoid blur on map overlays, use solid high-contrast surfaces instead.
No frosted glass for critical emergency CTAs.

screens.name: Customer Home
screens.purpose: Interactive map with nearby mechanics and immediate breakdown request access.

states.loading: Map skeleton with centered signal red spinner.
states.error: Full screen error overlay 'Unable to fetch location' with retry button.

screens.layout: Full-bleed Map view. A floating profile/wallet pill at the top left. A massive, high-contrast, circular 'SOS' button floating bottom right. A Bottom Sheet docked at the bottom containing the 'Request Assistance' entry point and breakdown categories grid. The bottom sheet header uses a solid surfaceSecondary with a drag handle.

screens.name: Booking Flow (Bottom Sheet)
screens.purpose: Step-by-step minimal input flow to request a mechanic.

states.empty: No mechanics available in the area message.

screens.layout: Step 1: Grid of breakdown categories (Flat Tyre, Battery, Tow, etc.) using brandTertiary tinted containers. Step 2: Vehicle Type selection row. Step 3: Photo upload and voice note UI. A sticky primary CTA 'Find Mechanic' pinned to the bottom.

screens.name: Live Tracking
screens.purpose: Real-time map tracking of the assigned mechanic and ETA.
screens.layout: Full-bleed map showing customer and moving mechanic markers. A stacked bottom module (solid surfaceSecondary) displaying mechanic details, ETA in large display typography (Rajdhani), and action buttons (Chat, Call, Cancel).

screens.name: Mechanic Dashboard
screens.purpose: Command center for the mechanic to view incoming requests, earnings, and active status.

states.empty: Illustration: No active jobs right now.

screens.layout: Top section: High-contrast Online/Offline toggle. Middle: Large segmented metric cards (Earnings, Jobs Completed) using display fonts. Bottom: List of incoming/active job cards with prominent 'Accept' primary buttons and 'Decline' secondary buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the 'Dark-First Utility DARK' personality strictly. Do not use pure black backgrounds; use the provided #121212 and #1E1E1E.
Do NOT use any blue, purple, or indigo colors across the application, as per the strict prohibition. The primary action color is Signal Red (#FF3B30).
Use Phosphor icons with consistent weights across all screens.
Implement real-time map styling in dark mode.
The Customer Home should focus on the map and a persistent Bottom Sheet for the request flow. Ensure the SOS button is heavily emphasized and floating above the sheet.
For the Mechanic Dashboard, emphasize large typography (Rajdhani) for metrics and clear active/inactive state visual differences.
Ensure the booking flow involves minimal steps: category selection -> vehicle type -> request.
Haptics MUST be wired to every primary button tap, toggle change, and category selection.
